en.sayed-ali-raza: 89. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:

If a man sets right matters between himself and Allāh, then Allāh sets right matters between him and other people; and if a man sets right the affairs of his next life then Allāh sets right for him the affairs of this world. Whoever is a preacher for himself is protected by Allāh.
